description:
After a 2 year wait, the new Jouta Blue Line Trikes are starting to arrive, and it was really worth the wait!!

The new Jouta line is now Aluminum and is lighter weight by almost 30%! In addition the new Jouta line now has indirect steering,

The 20″ Tadpole is now in stock and ready to ship.

There is also an Electric Version of the Tadpole that comes standard with Big Apple Tires , an Enviolo 380 Hub, and a 500W 48V Tong Sheng Mid Drive. It retails for $3499.00

Tandem Kit for Jouta Tadpole is now available! Only fits the new Aluminum Jouta Line

Shipping is $125.00 and is added to the total price in the cart. The Jouta Tadpole is 65% assembled (in 1 Box). Jouta is a Modular Trike line so you can make it into a Tandem Trike by adding the Jouta Tandem Kit. Please call for shipping quotes to AK, HI, Canada or any foreign address.
